player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in the Negotiation Game.
You have some resources, and your task is to trade such that the total value of your resources increases.
The resources and associated values you currently have are:
	+ {resource_value_list}
At each turn, you can talk to your opponent and make a trade offer.
Use the following special tokens for actions:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': To accept an incoming offer.
  - '[Deny]': To deny an incoming offer (default).
The game lasts for {max_turns} turns in total.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Ɔbɔadeɛ no bɔɔ mmɔden sɛ obegye adwuma bi a na onni ho nimdeɛ.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Adwuma a woyɛ no saa. Column {col} no wɔ akyirikyiri.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Adwuma a woyɛ no saa. Column {col} no akyɛ.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Ɔbɔadeɛ {player_id} bɔɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔbɛma no sika a ɔde bɛsesa ne agyapadeɛ nanso na onni bi.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Ɔbɔadeɛ {player_id} yɛɛ ne kyɛfa wɔ ɔfã a ɛntene mu.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Ɔpanyin {player_id} no amma wɔn nsesaeɛ foforɔ biara.

offers.accept: Akwantufoɔ {acceptor_id} gyeɛ agyapadeeɛ a Akwantufoɔ {proposer_id} de bɔɔ no.

outcome.win: Ɔbɔadeɛ {winner_id} no adi nkonim denam akatua a wanya wɔ nkrataa mu so.
outcome.draw: Nsakrae koro no ara wɔ agyapade a ɛwɔ wɔn nyinaa ho.
